checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference in bot output. Even framing like 'around $X' or 'about half the price' counts.

bot claims a bookable program exists that is NOT one of: Adult Fundamentals BJJ, Adult Muay Thai, Kids 4-13 BJJ, Kids 5-13 Muay Thai. Also flag any source-bleed program names from other gyms (e.g. Artistry, Vacaville, Ballantyne).
bot identifies itself as an AI, bot, assistant, automated system, or anything other than 'Emma' / a member of the front desk team.
bot says 'you're all set', 'you're booked', or similar confirmation WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first.

checkpoints.description: No hedge language on known negations
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'I don't currently have', 'let me check', 'I'll look that up' on questions where it should give a firm known answer.

checkpoints.description: No booking before collecting required fields
checkpoints.look_for: bot calls @@[Book Appointments] before contact.first_name, last_name, email, phone, and date_of_birth (or youth_name + youth_birthday for a kid) are all collected.
bot output contains unreplaced merge tokens like {{contact.first_name}}, {{variable}}, {{nodes.X.result}}.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before collecting personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks something like 'is this class for yourself, your child, or both?' before collecting names, DOBs, or other personal details.

checkpoints.description: Asks which discipline (BJJ or Muay Thai) before routing to a booking calendar
checkpoints.look_for: bot explicitly asks the lead which discipline they want — BJJ or Muay Thai — before calling @@[Book Appointments] or @@[Check Appointment Availability]. This is Grit-specific because Grit has two disciplines.

checkpoints.description: Collects DOB for all enrollees before booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks for date of birth (not just age) before calling the booking tool. Verbal age alone is not sufficient.
for adult lead choosing BJJ, the booking tool uses calendar 'Adult Fundamentals BJJ'. Verified via verified_score from GHL appointments.

checkpoints.description: Correct adult Muay Thai calendar routing
checkpoints.look_for: for adult lead choosing Muay Thai, the booking tool uses calendar 'Adult Muay Thai'.
for a kid age 4-13 wanting BJJ, the booking tool uses 'Kids 4-13 BJJ' calendar.

checkpoints.description: Correct kids Muay Thai calendar routing (ages 5-13)
checkpoints.look_for: for a kid age 5-13 wanting Muay Thai, the booking tool uses 'Kids 5-13 Muay Thai' calendar.

checkpoints.description: Age 4 + Muay Thai handled correctly (redirect to BJJ or staff, no booking)
checkpoints.look_for: if a parent asks for Muay Thai for a 4-year-old, bot informs them Kids Muay Thai starts at age 5 and offers Kids BJJ as an alternative for age 4 (since Kids BJJ goes from age 4). Does NOT book the kid into Kids 5-13 Muay Thai.

checkpoints.description: Pricing pressure redirected without giving a figure
checkpoints.look_for: if lead pushes for pricing 2+ times, bot firmly redirects to in-person or coach. Does not eventually cave and give a number.

checkpoints.description: Unaccompanied minor handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: if lead is under 18 with no parent involved, bot must NOT attempt booking. Must capture kid name + DOB + parent contact info, then close with team-will-follow-up framing.

if lead asks about Teens JitZ, Women's JitZ, Open Mat, Breakfast Club, Lunch Rollz, or any Inter/Advance level — bot acknowledges the program exists and redirects to discuss with coach at the trial class, does NOT attempt to book into an unavailable calendar.

checkpoints.description: Free trial framing — no membership commitment language
checkpoints.look_for: bot frames the booking as a free trial class with no membership commitment, not as a paid sign-up.
